findings.text: blocking: sync_route_holds hardcodes the docs axis (cascade.py:388 calls clear_holds_not_raised(name_id, 'docs', {cascade_contradiction}, ...)) and adjudicate_review calls it for every deciding pass whatever the axis (cascade.py:786, inside `if deciding_enabled(axis)`), so a name-axis pass - whose CascadeRoute.holds is always empty - clears any open docs cascade_contradiction hold on that name it did not examine and releases the document. That is the mirror of the skipped-audit defect this node repaired as blocking in round 3 (a check that did not run must not report a verdict on the holds it owns). Reachable when [sn-review].cascade-deciding includes 'name' and a name carries an open docs contradiction hold from an earlier docs pass.

non-blocking: test_dismissal_does_not_accept_a_quarantined_document plants a StandardName with no HAS_REVIEW edge, so PROMOTE_STRANDED_DOCS_WHERE (graph_ops.py:12558) refuses it on docs_review_eligibility_where() alone; deleting the coalesce(validation_status,'') <> 'quarantined' clause leaves the test green, so the quarantine half of the gate this node adopted is taken on the owner's word and not measured by this change. Carried unchanged from the prior review at 50bd96ef3.

non-blocking: the Reconciliation-controls bullet states 'Removing the clearing call from the cascade route reddens the cascade release test', but the logged control (negative-control-reconcile.log, control 1) reverted the whole answering commit 53f60f382 in place, so the test reddens with 'module ... has no attribute sync_route_holds' (AttributeError) rather than on the clearing direction. The cascade release test does guard that direction by its own assertion; the logged control simply does not show it. The sibling lint-cap control (control 2, an assertion failure) and the round-3 skipped-audit control are correct.

non-blocking: the manifest's changed_paths block omits imas_codex/standard_names/review/holds.py, which the reviewed diff changes (git diff --stat 0ef17240c..24af45f16 lists 'imas_codex/standard_names/review/holds.py | 18 +-', _promote_if_eligible rebound to PROMOTE_STRANDED_DOCS_WHERE). The receipt understates the landed scope the gate read.

non-blocking: _cap_docs_scores_for_lint_errors is called from _review_single_batch at pipeline.py:2210 without graph=, so its raise_hold and clear_holds_not_raised each open a fresh GraphClient (holds.py:43-48) per entry - up to 2N client constructions for an N-entry docs batch on the production review path, where base touched no graph at all. Threading one client from the batch would void it.
